correctness.rationale: All-dimensional problem reduces to the joint two-dimensional projector span. Equal 2-by-2 trace/determinant gives equal Frobenius norms; a verified exact projector contraction against the closed-form semigroup yields the signed formula. Strict monotonicity of rate times coth(rate step/2) proves the all-step ordering and equality cases. Symbolic computation, 45 exact-rational substitutions and 120 independent matrix-exponential tests supplement the displayed complete analytic proof; no numerical experiment is presented as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Fixes a practical ambiguity between two equal-cost symmetric Strang arrangements on a minimal reversible three-state diffusion model. Supplies an exact, step-independent ordering policy plus sharp equality conditions rather than local heuristic, and exposes a difference in accuracy invisible to the shared spectrum and Frobenius norm of both products. The scope is intentionally finite and self-contained; it does not claim better accuracy for every initial condition.
